title: The Nihilist Reading Of Sentenced to Be a Hero #Shorts
description:
Every serious account of Sentenced to Be a Hero eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. Sentenced to Be a Hero: The Prison Records of Penal Hero Unit 9004 (Japanese: 勇者刑に処す 懲罰勇者9004隊刑務記録, Hepburn: Yūsha-kei ni Shosu: Chōbatsu Yūsha Kyūmarumaruyon-tai Keimu Kiroku), or simply Sentenced to Be a Hero, is a Japanese light novel series written by Rocket Shōkai and illustrated by Mephisto. The story follows Xylo Forbartz, a former knight who becomes the leader of a penal unit after being wrongly accused and sentenced, later joining forces with the goddess Teoritta to battle the hordes of demonic beings that threaten humanity.

Nothing in Sentenced to Be a Hero was built for you — it was built for reproduction. Despite everything, she apparently still cares for Xylo and actively works to secure his pardon. She has a habit of comparing people and situations to strange animals or objects, and her presence around Xylo often sparks jealousy around Teoritta and Kivia.
